component.name: Cardmarket Price Updater
component.summary: Update card collection prices from Cardmarket in a spreadsheet

description.p: Reads a spreadsheet of Magic: The Gathering, Pokémon or Yu-Gi-Oh! cards identified by Cardmarket product ID, fetches current prices from Cardmarket's price guide, and writes them back into the sheet in GBP, EUR or USD.

ul.li: Changed the license from Apache 2.0 to a Personal Use License.
The Flatpak release information and update.xml now update automatically on release.
update.xml is only updated once the new Windows exe is available to download.
Fixed known security vulnerabilities in packages used by EPPlus (System.Security.Cryptography.Xml and System.Security.Cryptography.Pkcs).
Corrected the license, links and release information in the Flatpak metadata.
Removed the leftover Flathub packaging (nuget-sources.json, the Flathub manifest and its docs). The Flatpak download on the releases page is unaffected.

description.p: Cross-platform Avalonia GUI, USD support, download retry/backoff, rotating backups, and a Linux/Flatpak build alongside Windows.
